fact: BEAC's 2024 report on payment services in the CEMAC states that Regulation 04/18 gives the central bank power over interoperability of payment systems (article 18) and that Instruction 001/GR/2024 of 22 January 2024 sets technical norms for electronic payment instruments.
title: RAPPORT SUR LES SERVICES DE PAIEMENT DANS LA CEMAC - DSMP-2024
publisher: Banque des États de l'Afrique centrale
